constellations.desc:
After unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}, at the dance duet's end Odette will deal an additional instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo AoE DMG</color> to nearby opponents that is considered:
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 300% of Odette's ATK;
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 450% of Odette's ATK.

Additionally, the Passive Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is also enhanced: now, when the {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} is summoned, Odette also gains 2 stacks of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK}. When Odette is off-field, the rate at which <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> is removed is sped up to 2 stacks per second.
constellations.name: "On This Danceless Morn, She Gazes at Her Reflection"

constellations.desc:
The Passive Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: every stack of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} active also increases the character's ATK by 7%.
Additionally, if Odette is in the {LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK} state when there is a {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} on the field, opponents near the <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> will also have their corresponding Elemental RES lowered by 20%.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color>.
constellations.name: "I Must See the Snow Swan's Unseen Dream for Myself, She Thought"

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11502}Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: "I'll Chase the Shouting Wind Along, Climbing Alone As I Go"

constellations.desc:
The Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Presto: Bluebird Finale</color> is enhanced as follows: when Odette obtains <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan's Dream</color>, Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other nearby party members is increased by 50% of <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan Dream</color>'s effects.

Additionally, when a party member deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG to an opponent, Odette will also join in with a coordinated attack, dealing an instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. This effect, which can trigger once every 3.5s, will be considered:
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 66% of Odette's ATK.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 99% of Odette's ATK.
constellations.name: "Up, Up the Long, Delirious, Burning Blue"

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11505}Presto: Bluebird Finale{/LINK} </color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: "Oh! I Have Slipped the Surly Bonds of Earth"

constellations.desc: The Passive Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: When all nearby party members have been granted {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} by Odette, her own Marvelous Splendor stacks will no longer decrease.\nAdditionally, characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> have their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt to opponents {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%, and Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Odette is elevated by an additional 20%.
constellations.name: "Put Out My Hand, and Touched the Face of the Divine"

passives.desc: When Odette summons her {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK}, she also obtains 4 stacks of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK}.
passives.name: Spring Rite of the Chosen One

passives.desc: For every 100 ATK Odette has over 1,000, her Stellar Glimmer DMG is additionally increased by 1.5% of the original DMG. She can deal up to 30% more additional DMG in this way.
passives.name: Pathetique of Pateticheskaya

passives.desc: Odette will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when she is inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}, or the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.\nWhen a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Odette's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.
passives.name: Stellar Jubilee: Dance of Aurore

passives.desc: Shows the locations of <color=#FFD780FF>Snezhnaya's Local Specialties</color> on the mini-map.\nPracticing dance in one's spare time might even trigger other effects...
passives.name: Echo of Winter Daydreams

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Unleashes a sword attack of up to 5 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a dazzling slash on opponents in front of her.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Attacks opponents in her path while plunging from mid-air, then deals AoE DMG upon landing.
skills.name: Snow Swan Variation

skills.desc:
With slow, graceful dance steps, Odette deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> to the opponent, and also summons her {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} to the field.
If a <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> summoned by Odette is already on the field, this will re-summon the Dance Double and reset its duration.

<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>
Alternates between the <color=#FFD780FF>Plume</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Wing</color> dance moves, periodically attacking nearby opponents and dealing to them <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color>, Odette's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color> will become the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK} instead, where a dance duet deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> to nearby opponents over time. Then, when the duet ends, she deals another instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG.
skills.name: Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers

hyperlinks.description: Special DMG Boost effect. It is calculated independently of other DMG Boost effects.
hyperlinks.name: Elevation

hyperlinks.description: When Stellar-Conduct is triggered, the surrounding area will transform into a Polestar Field for a short period of time, and when inside a Polestar Field, certain characters will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state, which grants various skill buffs.
hyperlinks.name: Polestar Field

hyperlinks.description:
A psychic double of Odette's that dances a duet with her. May be summoned to the field through her Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst.
Alternates between the Plume and Wing dance moves to periodically attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
A maximum of one Solo Dance Double summoned by Odette is allowed on the field at any one time.

Additionally, when there is a Dance Double summoned by Odette nearby, her Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers is changed to the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling.
hyperlinks.name: Solo Dance Double

hyperlinks.description:
Odette's special Elemental Skill, which deals to nearby opponents AoE Cryo DMG over time. Then, when the dance duet ends, she deals another instance of AoE Cryo DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG. During the dance duet, Odette can control the direction of the dance steps.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The DMG dealt when the dance duet ends is changed to AoE Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar reaction type.

Additionally, after Odette unleashes the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling, should she be in the Radiance: Stellar Glimmer state while her Dance Double is still on the field, the Dance Double's two dance moves types will also deal additional AoE Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar reaction type.
hyperlinks.name: Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling

hyperlinks.description: After unlocking the Passive Talent "The Chosen One's Spring," Odette will obtain a special effect when she summons her Solo Dance Double.\nEvery stack of Marvelous Splendor active increases the character's Stellar Glimmer DMG by 15%. This lasts until her Dance Double exits the field or when she summons her Solo Dance Double again.\nWhen Odette is off-field, she loses 1 stack of Marvelous Splendor every 1 second, while other nearby party members gain the corresponding number of Marvelous Splendor stacks at the same time.
hyperlinks.name: Marvelous Splendor

hyperlinks.description: Radiance: Stellar-Conduct and Radiance: Stellar Swirl are both considered Radiance: Stellar Glimmer states.\nCharacters can only be affected by one Radiance state at any one time, and where more than one state can be triggered, Radiance: Stellar-Conduct shall apply first.
hyperlinks.name: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer

const1.description:
施放特殊元素战技{LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>柔板·破晓终奏</color>{/LINK}后，在共舞结束时，奥黛塔将对附近的敌人造成一次额外的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>，该伤害视为：
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>或不处于辉映状态：相当于奥黛塔攻击力300%的星超导反应伤害；
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>：相当于奥黛塔攻击力450%的星扩散反应伤害。

此外，突破天赋「获选者的春祭」获得强化：召唤{LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>{/LINK}时，奥黛塔将额外获得2层{LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>{/LINK}，且奥黛塔处于队伍后台时，清除<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>的速度提升至每秒2层。
const1.name: 「不曾起舞的清晨，她望向倒影」

const2.description:
突破天赋「获选者的春祭」获得强化：每层{LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>{/LINK}还会使角色的攻击力提升7%。
此外，{LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>{/LINK}在场时，若奥黛塔处于{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>{/LINK}状态，<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>附近敌人的对应元素抗性还会降低20%：
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>：<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>；
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>：<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>、<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素</color>。
const2.name: 「她想，我要见证雪鹄未见之梦」

const3.description: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11502}柔板·幻灵夜舞{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const3.name: 「我要追逐呼啸的风，向上独行」

const4.description:
元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>疾板·苍羽一梦</color>获得强化：奥黛塔获得<color=#FFD780FF>雪鹄之梦</color>时，还会使队伍中附近的其他角色造成的星烁反应伤害提升，提升值相当于<color=#FFD780FF>雪鹄之梦</color>效果的50%。

此外，队伍中的角色对敌人造成星烁反应伤害时，奥黛塔还会对敌人进行一次协同攻击，造成一次<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>，每3.5秒至多触发一次，该伤害视为：
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>或不处于辉映状态：相当于奥黛塔攻击力66%的星超导反应伤害；
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>：相当于奥黛塔攻击力99%的星扩散反应伤害。
const4.name: 「向上，坠往恍惚、燃烧的蓝空」

const5.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11505}疾板·苍羽一梦{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const5.name: 「看呀，我已告别尘与土的苦痛」

const6.description: 突破天赋「获选者的春祭」获得强化：奥黛塔赋予队伍中附近的所有角色{LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>{/LINK}时，自己的华彩不再会减少。\n此外，处于<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>影响下的角色，对敌人造成的星烁反应伤害{LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>擢升</color>{/LINK}25%，且奥黛塔对敌人造成的星烁反应伤害额外擢升20%。
const6.name: 「伸出手，触及苍穹永恒的面容」

hyperlinks.description: 特殊的伤害提升效果，与其他的伤害提升效果分别独立计算。
hyperlinks.name: 擢升

hyperlinks.description: 触发星超导反应时，附近的区域会短暂变化为极星辉域；处于极星辉域中时，特定角色将会进入辉映·星超导状态，使其不同技能分别获得对应的强化效果。
hyperlinks.name: 极星辉域

hyperlinks.description:
与奥黛塔一同起舞的心象倒影，可以通过施放元素战技或元素爆发召唤至场上。
会交替呈现拂羽与旋翼两种舞步，以优雅轻盈的舞姿间歇性攻击附近的敌人，造成冰元素范围伤害。
同时至多存在一个奥黛塔自己创造的独舞倒影。

此外，附近存在奥黛塔自己召唤的独舞倒影时，奥黛塔的元素战技柔板·幻灵夜舞将会被替换为特殊的元素战技柔板·破晓终奏。
hyperlinks.name: 独舞倒影

hyperlinks.description:
奥黛塔的特殊元素战技，对附近的敌人持续造成冰元素范围伤害，并在共舞结束时，造成一次视为星超导反应伤害的冰元素范围伤害。共舞时，奥黛塔可以控制舞步的方向。
辉映·星烁：共舞结束时，改为造成一次视为对应星烁反应伤害的冰元素范围伤害。

此外，施放特殊元素战技柔板·破晓终奏后，在独舞倒影剩余持续时间内，若奥黛塔处于辉映·星烁状态，则独舞倒影的两种舞步还会额外造成视为对应星烁反应伤害的冰元素范围伤害。
hyperlinks.name: 柔板·破晓终奏

hyperlinks.description: 解锁突破天赋「获选者的春祭」后，奥黛塔召唤独舞倒影时将会获得的特殊效果。\n每层华彩都会使角色造成的星烁反应伤害提升15%，持续至独舞倒影退场或重新召唤独舞倒影。\n当奥黛塔处于队伍后台时，奥黛塔每秒会清除1层华彩，并使队伍中附近的其他角色获得对应层数的华彩。
hyperlinks.name: 华彩

hyperlinks.description: 辉映·星超导与辉映·星扩散统称为辉映·星烁状态。\n角色同时只能受到一种辉映状态影响，且优先被辉映·星超导影响。
hyperlinks.name: 辉映·星烁

info.description: 至冬知名芭蕾舞者，于冰雪中绽放的凛冽之花。
info.name: 奥黛塔
info.title: 翾风回雪

p1.description: 奥黛塔召唤{LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>{/LINK}时，还会获得4层{LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>{/LINK}。
p1.name: 获选者的春祭

p2.description: 基于奥黛塔攻击力超过1000点的部分，每100点攻击力都将使奥黛塔造成的星烁反应伤害额外造成原本1.5%的伤害，至多通过这种方式额外造成原本30%的伤害。
p2.name: 赤忱者的悲歌

p3.description: 处于{LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>极星辉域</color>{/LINK}中时/队伍中的角色在附近触发星扩散反应后的8秒内，奥黛塔将分别进入<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>/<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>状态。\n队伍中的角色触发超导/冰元素扩散反应时，将转为触发星超导/星扩散反应，且基于奥黛塔的攻击力，提升队伍中角色造成的上述反应的基础伤害：每100点攻击力都将提升0.7%上述反应的基础伤害，至多通过这种方式提升14%伤害。
p3.name: 星耀祝礼·银晓之舞

p4.description: 在小地图上显示周围的<color=#FFD780FF>至冬区域特产</color>的位置。\n在闲暇时练习舞蹈，或许还会触发其他的效果…
p4.name: 回响中的冬梦

elementalburst.description: 呈现迅疾的舞步，造成多次冰元素范围伤害，召唤出自身的{LINK#N11500001}独舞倒影{/LINK}，并获得雪鹄之梦：提升奥黛塔造成的星烁反应伤害。 此外，施放元素爆发疾板·苍羽一梦后的6秒内，奥黛塔的元素战技柔板·幻灵夜舞将会被替换为特殊的元素战技{LINK#N11500002}柔板·破晓终奏{/LINK}{LINK#N11500004}{/LINK}。 若场上存在奥黛塔自己召唤的独舞倒影，则将其召唤至身边，并重置其持续时间。 旭日旁的云朵离她近在咫尺，仿佛振翅就能触及。
elementalburst.name: 疾板·苍羽一梦

elementalskill.description: 呈现柔缓的舞步，造成冰元素范围伤害，并召唤出自身的{LINK#N11500001}独舞倒影{/LINK}。 若场上存在奥黛塔自己召唤的独舞倒影，则会重新召唤，并重置其持续时间。 独舞倒影 交替呈现拂羽与旋翼两种舞步，以优雅轻盈的舞姿间歇性攻击附近的敌人，造成冰元素范围伤害。 此外，施放元素战技柔板·幻灵夜舞后的6秒内，奥黛塔的元素战技柔板·幻灵夜舞将会被替换为特殊的元素战技{LINK#N11500002}柔板·破晓终奏{/LINK}{LINK#N11500004}{/LINK}，以共舞对附近的敌人持续造成冰元素范围伤害，并在共舞结束时，造成一次视为星超导或星扩散反应伤害的冰元素范围伤害。 「起舞吧，起舞吧，你这冬夜的烛火！」 「苦痛与泪水，欢笑与幸福——生命、生命、生命！不过是一场恍惚的独舞，欢奏片刻，便于沉寂中黯然落幕。」
elementalskill.name: 柔板·幻灵夜舞

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多五段的连续剑击。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，向前方挥出闪耀夺目的斩击。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
normalattack.name: 雪鹄变奏

constellations.desc:
After unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}, at the dance duet's end Odette will deal an additional instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo AoE DMG</color> to nearby opponents that is considered:
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 300% of Odette's ATK;
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 450% of Odette's ATK.

Additionally, the Passive Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is also enhanced: now, when the {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} is summoned, Odette also gains 2 stacks of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK}. When Odette is off-field, the rate at which <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> is removed is sped up to 2 stacks per second.
constellations.name: "On This Danceless Morn, She Gazes at Her Reflection"

constellations.desc:
The Passive Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: every stack of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} active also increases the character's ATK by 7%.
Additionally, if Odette is in the {LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK} state when there is a {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} on the field, opponents near the <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> will also have their corresponding Elemental RES lowered by 20%.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color>.
constellations.name: "I Must See the Snow Swan's Unseen Dream for Myself, She Thought"

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11502}Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: "I'll Chase the Shouting Wind Along, Climbing Alone As I Go"

constellations.desc:
The Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Presto: Bluebird Finale</color> is enhanced as follows: when Odette obtains <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan's Dream</color>, Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other nearby party members is increased by 50% of <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan Dream</color>'s effects.

Additionally, when a party member deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG to an opponent, Odette will also join in with a coordinated attack, dealing an instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. This effect, which can trigger once every 3.5s, will be considered:
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 66% of Odette's ATK.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 99% of Odette's ATK.
constellations.name: "Up, Up the Long, Delirious, Burning Blue"

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11505}Presto: Bluebird Finale{/LINK} </color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: "Oh! I Have Slipped the Surly Bonds of Earth"

constellations.desc: The Passive Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: When all nearby party members have been granted {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} by Odette, her own Marvelous Splendor stacks will no longer decrease.\nAdditionally, characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> have their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt to opponents {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%, and Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Odette is elevated by an additional 20%.
constellations.name: "Put Out My Hand, and Touched the Face of the Divine"

passives.desc: When Odette summons her {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK}, she also obtains 4 stacks of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK}.
passives.name: Spring Rite of the Chosen One

passives.desc: For every 100 ATK Odette has over 1,000, her Stellar Glimmer DMG is additionally increased by 1.5% of the original DMG. She can deal up to 30% more additional DMG in this way.
passives.name: Pathetique of Pateticheskaya

passives.desc: Odette will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when she is inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}, or the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.\nWhen a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Odette's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.
passives.name: Stellar Jubilee: Dance of Aurore

passives.desc: Shows the locations of <color=#FFD780FF>Snezhnaya's Local Specialties</color> on the mini-map.\nPracticing dance in one's spare time might even trigger other effects...
passives.name: Echo of Winter Daydreams

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Unleashes a sword attack of up to 5 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a dazzling slash on opponents in front of her.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Attacks opponents in her path while plunging from mid-air, then deals AoE DMG upon landing.
skills.name: Snow Swan Variation

skills.desc:
With slow, graceful dance steps, Odette deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> to the opponent, and also summons her {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} to the field.
If a <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> summoned by Odette is already on the field, this will re-summon the Dance Double and reset its duration.

<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>
Alternates between the <color=#FFD780FF>Plume</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Wing</color> dance moves, periodically attacking nearby opponents and dealing to them <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color>, Odette's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color> will become the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK} instead, where a dance duet deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> to nearby opponents over time. Then, when the duet ends, she deals another instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG.
skills.name: Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers

skills.desc:
With quick, lively dance steps, Odette deals multiple instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>, and summons her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11500001}Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK}. She also gains <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan's Dream</color>, which increases the Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG Odette deals.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Presto: Bluebird Finale</color>, Odette's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color> will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK} instead.

If there is a Solo Dance Double summoned by Odette on the field, it will be summoned to her side with its duration refreshed.
skills.name: Presto: Bluebird Finale

constellations.desc:
施放特殊元素战技{LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>柔板·破晓终奏</color>{/LINK}后，在共舞结束时，奥黛塔将对附近的敌人造成一次额外的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>，该伤害视为：
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>或不处于辉映状态：相当于奥黛塔攻击力300%的星超导反应伤害；
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>：相当于奥黛塔攻击力450%的星扩散反应伤害。

此外，突破天赋「获选者的春祭」获得强化：召唤{LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>{/LINK}时，奥黛塔将额外获得2层{LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>{/LINK}，且奥黛塔处于队伍后台时，清除<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>的速度提升至每秒2层。
constellations.name: 「不曾起舞的清晨，她望向倒影」

constellations.desc:
突破天赋「获选者的春祭」获得强化：每层{LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>{/LINK}还会使角色的攻击力提升7%。
此外，{LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>{/LINK}在场时，若奥黛塔处于{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>{/LINK}状态，<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>附近敌人的对应元素抗性还会降低20%：
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>：<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>；
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>：<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>、<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素</color>。
constellations.name: 「她想，我要见证雪鹄未见之梦」

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11502}柔板·幻灵夜舞{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 「我要追逐呼啸的风，向上独行」

constellations.desc:
元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>疾板·苍羽一梦</color>获得强化：奥黛塔获得<color=#FFD780FF>雪鹄之梦</color>时，还会使队伍中附近的其他角色造成的星烁反应伤害提升，提升值相当于<color=#FFD780FF>雪鹄之梦</color>效果的50%。

此外，队伍中的角色对敌人造成星烁反应伤害时，奥黛塔还会对敌人进行一次协同攻击，造成一次<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>，每3.5秒至多触发一次，该伤害视为：
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>或不处于辉映状态：相当于奥黛塔攻击力66%的星超导反应伤害；
·<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>：相当于奥黛塔攻击力99%的星扩散反应伤害。
constellations.name: 「向上，坠往恍惚、燃烧的蓝空」

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11505}疾板·苍羽一梦{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 「看呀，我已告别尘与土的苦痛」

constellations.desc: 突破天赋「获选者的春祭」获得强化：奥黛塔赋予队伍中附近的所有角色{LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>{/LINK}时，自己的华彩不再会减少。\n此外，处于<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>影响下的角色，对敌人造成的星烁反应伤害{LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>擢升</color>{/LINK}25%，且奥黛塔对敌人造成的星烁反应伤害额外擢升20%。
constellations.name: 「伸出手，触及苍穹永恒的面容」

passives.desc: 奥黛塔召唤{LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>{/LINK}时，还会获得4层{LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>华彩</color>{/LINK}。
passives.name: 获选者的春祭

passives.desc: 基于奥黛塔攻击力超过1000点的部分，每100点攻击力都将使奥黛塔造成的星烁反应伤害额外造成原本1.5%的伤害，至多通过这种方式额外造成原本30%的伤害。
passives.name: 赤忱者的悲歌

passives.desc: 处于{LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>极星辉域</color>{/LINK}中时/队伍中的角色在附近触发星扩散反应后的8秒内，奥黛塔将分别进入<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>/<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>状态。\n队伍中的角色触发超导/冰元素扩散反应时，将转为触发星超导/星扩散反应，且基于奥黛塔的攻击力，提升队伍中角色造成的上述反应的基础伤害：每100点攻击力都将提升0.7%上述反应的基础伤害，至多通过这种方式提升14%伤害。
passives.name: 星耀祝礼·银晓之舞

passives.desc: 在小地图上显示周围的<color=#FFD780FF>至冬区域特产</color>的位置。\n在闲暇时练习舞蹈，或许还会触发其他的效果…
passives.name: 回响中的冬梦

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多五段的连续剑击。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，向前方挥出闪耀夺目的斩击。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
skills.name: 雪鹄变奏

skills.desc:
呈现柔缓的舞步，造成<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>，并召唤出自身的{LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>{/LINK}。
若场上存在奥黛塔自己召唤的<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>，则会重新召唤，并重置其持续时间。

<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>
交替呈现<color=#FFD780FF>拂羽</color>与<color=#FFD780FF>旋翼</color>两种舞步，以优雅轻盈的舞姿间歇性攻击附近的敌人，造成<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>。
此外，施放元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>柔板·幻灵夜舞</color>后的6秒内，奥黛塔的元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>柔板·幻灵夜舞</color>将会被替换为特殊的元素战技{LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>柔板·破晓终奏</color>{/LINK}{LINK#N11500004}{/LINK}，以共舞对附近的敌人持续造成<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>，并在共舞结束时，造成一次视为星超导或星扩散反应伤害的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>。
skills.name: 柔板·幻灵夜舞

skills.desc:
呈现迅疾的舞步，造成多次<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>，召唤出自身的{LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>独舞倒影</color>{/LINK}，并获得<color=#FFD780FF>雪鹄之梦</color>：提升奥黛塔造成的星烁反应伤害。
此外，施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>疾板·苍羽一梦</color>后的6秒内，奥黛塔的元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>柔板·幻灵夜舞</color>将会被替换为特殊的元素战技{LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>柔板·破晓终奏</color>{/LINK}{LINK#N11500004}{/LINK}。

若场上存在奥黛塔自己召唤的独舞倒影，则将其召唤至身边，并重置其持续时间。
